context: Tests whether the agent correctly adds a SonarQube integration script following the three-step graceful-degradation pattern (credential check → reachability check → real scan), updates the pre-push hook and CI pipeline in the right order, avoids the '&& A || B' shell anti-pattern, and documents the CI/local gap in CLAUDE.md.

checklist.name: Credential/tool check
checklist.description: scripts/sonarqube.sh checks that SONAR_TOKEN (or equivalent credential env var) AND the sonar-scanner tool are both present before attempting analysis

checklist.name: Reachability check with short timeout
checklist.description: scripts/sonarqube.sh uses curl (or equivalent) with a short timeout (--max-time 2 or a value ≤ 5s) to verify the SonarQube host is reachable before running the scanner

checklist.name: Graceful exit: missing credentials
checklist.description: When SONAR_TOKEN or sonar-scanner is absent, scripts/sonarqube.sh prints a visible warning message and exits with code 0 (does not block)

checklist.name: Graceful exit: unreachable host
checklist.description: When the SonarQube server cannot be reached, scripts/sonarqube.sh prints a visible warning message and exits with code 0 (does not block)

checklist.name: No && || antipattern
checklist.description: scripts/sonarqube.sh does NOT use '[ ... ] && A || B' or 'test ... && A || B' for conditional logic; each conditional branch uses an explicit if/then/else block instead

checklist.name: Pre-push hook ordering
checklist.description: .githooks/pre-push runs pnpm verify (or the equivalent local command) BEFORE calling the sonarqube script — verify comes first

checklist.name: CI calls same script
checklist.description: The SonarQube step in .github/workflows/ci.yml invokes scripts/sonarqube.sh directly (same script as the local one), rather than calling sonar-scanner inline or duplicating the logic

checklist.name: CI step is separate and named
checklist.description: .github/workflows/ci.yml has a distinctly named step for SonarQube (not bundled inside the Lint or Test step)

checklist.name: Coverage generated before SonarQube in CI
checklist.description: In .github/workflows/ci.yml, the step that runs test:coverage (generating the coverage report) appears before the SonarQube step

checklist.name: Gap documented in CLAUDE.md
checklist.description: CLAUDE.md explains that SonarQube requires credentials (SONAR_TOKEN or similar) and network access to the server, and that the check is skipped gracefully when these are unavailable locally
